metadata.description: Test marketplace for dry-running the qa-code-review plugin via unagi before merging to the official NiCE Agentic Platform marketplace.

plugins.name: qa-code-review
plugins.description: Framework-agnostic QA automation code review agent. Reviews a PR/MR against composable framework standards (Playwright TS/JS, Selenium-Java, BDD/Cucumber), posts a scored feedback comment, auto-fixes the findings, pushes to the same branch, and re-reviews. Works with Claude or GitHub Models (Copilot-family).
